label: Commit on the feature branch; I push and merge
rule: Commit to your feature branch as you go, in small, described steps. When the task is verified, report the branch name so it can be reviewed, pushed and merged.

label: Commit, push the branch and open a draft PR
rule: Commit to your feature branch as you go, push the branch, and open a draft pull request into master once the task is verified. Merging is done through review.

label: Leave changes uncommitted for review
rule: Leave your changes uncommitted on the feature branch, so the whole task can be reviewed as one working-tree diff. Report the branch name when the task is verified.
